title: Farmslot Recipe Protocol v1
description: A parameterized, composable workflow that executes actions or other recipes and records explicit proof claims.

$schema.description: Canonical Recipe Protocol v1 schema URL used by editors and validators.

description.description: What the recipe does and the outcome it is designed to prove.

paramsSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema for caller-supplied recipe parameters.

proofTargets.description: Claims this recipe can prove; workflow nodes link to them through proves.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by workflow node proves entries.

claim.description: Human-readable statement that successful linked nodes establish.

workflow.description: Executable graph containing the entry node, optional teardown node, and named nodes.

type.description: Recipe parameters are always supplied as one object.

additionalProperties.description: Reject caller parameters that the recipe does not declare.

required.description: Parameter names callers must provide when no default satisfies them.

properties.description: Named parameter definitions available to callers and call nodes.

type.description: Allowed JSON value type or types for this parameter.

description.description: Human-readable parameter help shown by recipe discovery and editors.

default.description: Value used when the caller omits this parameter.

enum.description: Exact values accepted for this parameter.

additionalProperties.description: Whether an object parameter may contain undeclared keys.

required.description: Required keys within an object parameter.

properties.description: Named child schemas for an object parameter.

items.description: Schema applied to each item of an array parameter.

next.description: Node id to execute after this node succeeds.

cases.description: Maps an action result case to the next node id.

default.description: Node id used when no declared result case matches.

action.description: Registered action name to execute; action-specific fields are declared by its manifest.

intent.description: Concise human-facing reason for performing this step.

next.description: Node id to execute after this node succeeds.

cases.description: Maps an action result case to the next node id.

default.description: Node id used when no declared result case matches.

proves.description: Proof target ids established by successful execution of this node.

action.description: Selects recipe composition instead of an action adapter.

intent.description: Concise human-facing reason for invoking the referenced recipe.

ref.description: Static recipe id resolved from configured recipe libraries.

params.description: Parameters passed to the referenced recipe; values may use supported parameter templates.

proves.description: Proof target ids established by successful completion of the called recipe.

next.description: Node id to execute after the called recipe succeeds.

status.description: Terminal recipe verdict returned by this path.

entry.description: Node id where normal recipe execution starts.

teardown.description: Optional node id executed once after the main graph exits to restore deterministic state.

nodes.description: Named action, recipe-call, and terminal nodes in the executable graph.
